items.title: Surge in displacement following fighting in southwest Yemen
items.summary: At least 46,000 people have been displaced since renewed fighting last week between Houthi rebels and pro-government forces in southwestern Yemen, the International Organization for Migration (IOM) reported on Friday.

items.title: Terrorist propaganda is outpacing global efforts to stop it, UN report finds
items.summary: Terrorist groups are recruiting, raising money and even planning operations through propaganda that is now “embedded” in every stage of their work, a new UN report warns – and governments are struggling to keep pace.
